results.name: Bodyweight Wall Squat
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet shoulder-width apart, positioned a few inches away from the wall.
Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and hips, allowing your buttocks to touch the wall first, then your entire torso.
Immediately push through your heels to stand back up, returning to the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Start the movement by engaging your glutes and core to maintain stability.
Ensure your knees are aligned with your toes and do not extend past your toes to prevent strain on your knees.
Move smoothly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
results.description: Bodyweight Wall Squat is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Box Jump
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart in front of a box.
Bend your knees and hips, swinging your arms back to prepare for the jump.
Explosively jump onto the box, landing softly with both feet.
Stand up fully on the box before stepping or jumping back down to the starting position.
tips: Focus on landing softly to reduce impact on your joints.
Engage your core throughout the jump to maintain stability and control.
Use your arms to generate momentum and help propel your body upward.
results.description: Box Jump is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the plyometric category. Secondary muscles: Calves.

results.name: Box Jump Squats
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart in front of a box.
Bend your knees and hips, swinging your arms back to prepare for the jump.
Explosively jump onto the box, landing softly in a squat position.
Jump back down to the floor, returning to the starting position and repeat.
tips: Focus on landing softly to reduce impact on your joints.
Engage your core throughout the jump to maintain stability and control.
Use your arms to generate momentum and help propel your body upward.
results.description: Box Jump Squats is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the plyometric category. Secondary muscles: Calves.

results.name: Bodyweight Bulgarian Split Squat (Left, 45 Degree View)
instructions: Stand a few feet in front of a bench or elevated surface, facing away from it. Place your right foot behind you on the bench, with the top of your foot resting on the surface.
Position your left foot firmly on the floor, a comfortable distance in front of the bench.
Lower your body by bending your left knee and hip, keeping your torso upright, until your left thigh is parallel to the floor.
Push through your left heel to return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
tips: Keep your front knee aligned with your toes to avoid putting unnecessary strain on your knee.
Focus on driving through the heel of your front foot to engage your glutes and quadriceps effectively.
Maintain a slight forward lean to help with balance and ensure proper form throughout the exercise.
results.description: Bodyweight Bulgarian Split Squat (Left, 45 Degree View) is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Bulgarian Split Squat Cable Resistance Band
instructions: Place one foot behind you on a bench or step, with your other foot forward. Secure the resistance band under your front foot.
Hold the handles of the resistance band with your palms facing forward, elbows bent, and hands raised near your shoulders. Keep your arms folded by your sides.
Lower your body towards the floor by bending the front knee, stopping just before your back knee touches the floor
Push through your front heel to return to the starting position. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
tips: Maintain an upright posture throughout the exercise to prevent leaning forward or arching your back.
Exhale as you push back up to the starting position and inhale as you lower down.
Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes to prevent strain on your knee joint.
results.description: Bulgarian Split Squat Cable Resistance Band is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves, Core.

results.name: Burpee Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms at your sides, ready to begin the movement.
Lower your body into a squat position and place your hands on the floor in front of you.
Step your right foot back, then your left foot, to land in a plank position, keeping your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Step your right foot forward, then your left foot, to return to the squat position, then stand up and repeat.
tips: Start with a moderate pace to master the form, then gradually increase your speed as you become more comfortable with the movement.
Engage your core to maintain stability and support your lower back throughout the exercise.
Focus on keeping your knees aligned with your toes during the squat to prevent unnecessary strain on your joints.
results.description: Burpee Squat is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the cardiovascular system (cardio). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the cardio category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.
